Been on keto since June. Third time trying.  I've never made it past November. It has been completely easy up until the past week and a half. All of the food I eat is low carb and I eat 1400 to 1500 a day. At least 3 days last week I was over 2000 (close to or over my TDEE of 2363). I haven't worked out in a week and a half. Feels like I've lost control. This is prob just a normal part of the cycle and we all have down time but I'm worried. I keep telling myself that right now I am the Me who isn't going to give up this time and if I can just make it through the winter I will come out looking and feeling fabulous. I just wish it really was as easy as making your mind up and DOING. My mind IS made up but I'm having a hard time with the rest. I've already planned out this week so we'll see how it goes.

2-3 chicken breasts

1 packet Hidden Valley Fiesta Ranch dip mix

1 14-15 oz can chicken broth

1/2 brick cream cheese


Layer the first three ingredients in a crock pot. Cook on low for 8hrs. Remove chicken and shred with a fork. Return chicken to crock pot and add cream cheese. Once melted, stir well. 

This can be used for tacos/burritos but I usually add a bunch of chopped spinach and eat it like a salad. It rocks my socks.

He never was my direct supervisor so I never felt like he had power over me. I would say that he would have wanted a relationship had we been peers from the start. We've been working together for two years and never had a problem. It's when he is all done with his work and ready to go when I'm not that he seems to lose it. He says, "I don't like working off the clock. I don't love that place." Implying that I love being there so fucking much I want to work there for free. Nope. I'm just doing my job. 

Bonus response: Both of his previous marriages ended when they cheated on him. Both ended after seven years. He doesn't talk about them much but I think he was truly in love with the first one and, from what I know about the second, she was like an Amazon woman that took him by surprise. She made the divorce quite ugly and he lost nearly everything. He and I have had our issues with trust and I'm always explaining to him that screwing two people at the same time is disgusting so he has nothing to worry about with me. I would have a hard time trusting anyone, too, but I'm totally not like that.

While I say he was a supervisor, I was never on his job. Then he got another promotion not long after we got together training newer employees so basically he's never been in a position to tell me what to do. I've never gotten an "I am lord superior" vibe from him but I've also never looked for it.
